aiṁ (5) śrī hrīṁ kulaputravaṭukanāthāya pādukāṃ || bali || mūśāsanāya pādukāṃ || dhyāna || aiṁ (5) mūśapṛṣṭhāsanasthaṃ ca sutrāṅga gajavaktrakaṃ | trinetraṃ paraśu laḍūkaṃ mūlākṣaṃ caiva dhārakaṃ || nāga jajñopavītāṅgaṃ sarvaṃ duritanāśanaṃ | eva vighnaharaṃ dhyātvā gaṇanātha mahāvaraṃ || dhyānapuṣpaṃ namaḥ ||
gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ gaiṁ gauṁ gaḥ glauṁ śrīkulagaṇeśvarāya pādukāṃ || bali || āvāhanādi || thana digapūjā || haṃsāsanāya namaḥ || gajāsanāya nama || aiṁ (5) prayāgamahākṣe aśitāṅgamahābhairavāya aṁ brahmāṇī śakti sahitāya hetukakṣetrapālāya surādhipataye namaḥ || thvate pūrvayā || āgneyasa || vṛṣāsanāya namaḥ || chāgāsanāya namaḥ || aiṁ (5) varuṇamahākṣetre rurumahābhairavāya kaṁ māheśvarī śakti sahitāya tripurāntaka kṣetrapālāya tejādhipataye namaḥ || dakṣiṇasa || mayūrāsanāya mahikhāsanāya namaḥ || aiṁ (5) oṃkārāpuramahākṣetra caṇḍamahā
bhairavāya vaṁ kaumālī śakti sahitāya agnivetāla kṣetrapālāya nama || nai(-)ṛtyasa || garuḍāsanāya namaḥ || narāsanāya namaḥ || aiṁ (5) aṭṭahāsamahākṣetra krodha mahābhairavāya ṭaṁ vaiṣṇavī śakti sahitāya agnijihvākṣetrapālāya rākṣasādhipataye namaḥ ||
paścimasa || mahiṣāsanāya namaḥ || makarāsanāya nama || aiṁ (5) oṃ jayanti mahākṣetre unmattamahābhairavāya taṁ vārāhī śakti sahitāya kālākṣa kṣetrapālāya jalādhipataye namaḥ || vāyuvyasa || gajāsanāye namaḥ || hariṇāsanāye namaḥ || aiṁ (5) oṃ caritalakṣetra mahābhairavāya paṁ indrāṇī śakti sahitāya kalālakṣa kṣetrapālāya pavanādhipataye namaḥ ||
uttarasa || pretāsanāye namaḥ || hayāsanāye namaḥ || aiṁ (5) oṃ ekāmraka mahākṣetra bhīṣaṇamahābhairavāya yaṁ cāmuṇḍā śakti sahitāya ekapādakṣetrapālāya dhanādhipataye namaḥ || īśānasa || siṃhāsanāye namaḥ || vṛṣāsanāye namaḥ || aiṁ (5) oṃ devīkoṭamāhākṣetra saṃhāramahābhairavāya śaṁ mahālakṣmī śakti sahitāya bhūtādhipataye namaḥ || garuḍāsanāye namaḥ || oṃ kūrmmapṛṣṭamahākṣetrapārāya adhādhipataye jvālinī śakti sahitāya dāmalādibhairavāya nāgādhipataye namaḥ || ūrddhasa || haṃśāsanāya namaḥ || oṃ dāmāra mahākṣetra ūrddhādhipataye jvalanī śakti sahitāya ḍāmalādhibhairavāya
svargādhipataye namaḥ ||

mantra || aiṁ (5) aghore hrāṁ thaghore hrīṁ ghoraghoratare huṁ phreṁ sarvataḥ sarva sarve hreṁ juṃ saḥ hrauṁ rudrarūpe hraḥ pādukāṃ || (5) || aiṁ (5) vajrakubjikāyai hsphrīṁ trailokyākaḥṣaṇī hrīṁ kāmāṅga drāvaṇī klīṁ strīṁ māhākṣobhakāriṇī aiṁ sauṁ saḥ śrīpādukāṃ || aiṁ (5) namo bhagavati hsphreṁ kubjikāyai śrāṁ śrīṁ śrūṁ khage aiṁ ghore aghore aghorāmukhī chāṁ chīṁ kiṇi (2) vircce pādukāṃ || aiṁ (5) namo bhagavati siddhe hsphrāṁ hsphrīṁ ṅa anaṇame aghorāmukhī chāṁ chīṁ kiṇi (2) vicce pādukāṃ ||
aiṁ (5) namo bhagavati hsphreṁ kubjike hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ ghore aghore aghorāmukhī chāṁ chīṁ kiṇi (2) vircce pādukāṃ || brahmaṇe pādukāṃ || viṣṇave (2) || rudrāya (2) || īśvarāya (2) || sadāśivāya (2) || oṃ juṃ saḥ amṛtīsamahābhairavāya mṛtyuñjayāya amṛtamahālakṣmī śakti sahitāya oṃ juṃ saḥ pādukāṃ || pakṣāye (2) || mārggaśilādi dvādaśamāsebhyo namaḥ || ṛtuve (2) || saṃvatsarāya (2) || kṣārādi saptasamudrebhyo namaḥ || indrādi daśalokapālebhyo namaḥ || ādityādi navagrahebhyo (2) || aśvinyādi aṣṭāviṃśa nakṣatrebhyo namaḥ || viskaṃbhādi saptāviṃśa yogebhyo namaḥ || pratipadādi ṣodaśatithibhyo namaḥ || meṣādi dvādaśarāśibhyo (2) || rudrādi ṣodaśadinamuhūtrebhyo namaḥ || girīśādi
ṣoḍaśarātrīmuhūtrebhyo namaḥ || gaṃgādi saptanadībhyo namaḥ || aśvasthāmādi aṣṭaciraṃjīvībhyo namaḥ || śātī namaḥ || vidyāye kalāya nivṛrtti pratiṣṭhāya namaḥ || aiṁ (5) hskṣmlvryūṁ kulavṛkṣamahāsena saṃmohana kalasatīrtha mantra devatā kalātatvāya ātmatatva vidyātatva śivatatvāye saṃpūrṇakarasāye pādukāṃ || (3) || balighorena || ṣaḍaṃgena saṃpūjya || āvāhanādi candanākṣata puṣpaṃ namaḥ || dhenumudrāṃ darśayet || jāpa || oṃ juṃ saḥ svāhā (10) ||

dhyāna || lākṣārasanibhā devī padmarāga samaprabhā | sarvaratnavicitrāṅgi ambikā bhūtavigrahā || aṣṭādaśabhujā devyā nānāpaharanaudyatā | nānāratnadharā devī trailokyanyānya vidyate || khaḍgapāśaṃkuśaṃ sarva kapālaṃ kulisa dhvajaṃ | rathāṅgaṃ ca tathā ghaṇṭhā navamantu varapradaṃ ||
pheṭakā dhanu pāśaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ | śūla mudgara vīnaṃ ca gaṇārtti cottare kare || mandaśaṃveṣṭhavidyāntu nadī bhūti visarppitā | grasanti pāṭakān sarvān cāmṛtāmṛtakodbhavān || dhyānapuṣpaṃ pādukāṃ ||
